title: Masked Neural Detection for Run-Length-Limited Channel Coding in Molecular Communication
abstract: arXiv:2606.12489v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Molecular communication (MC) suffers from severe diffusion memory because molecules released for one symbol may arrive during later symbol intervals. Neural sequence detectors, especially sliding bidirectional recurrent neural networks (SBRNNs), substantially outperform threshold detection in such channels. This raises a central question for MC channel coding: does a code whose superiority was established under threshold detection retain it when both coded and uncoded transmission are evaluated with neural detection? This letter answers this question for run-length-limited ISI-mitigation (RLIM) codes by proposing a decoder-aware training mask that removes the positions the RLIM decoder has a high probability of deterministically overwriting, steering compact-SBRNN capacity toward the information-bearing positions. The masked RLIM$_2$-SBRNN beats the best uncoded receiver (threshold or SBRNN) at 40 of 57 operating points; gains

translated_title: 分子通信中游程受限信道编码的掩码神经检测
translated_abstract: 分子通信（MC）因扩散记忆效应而受到严重影响，因为针对某一符号释放的分子可能在后续符号间隔内才到达。神经序列检测器，尤其是滑动双向递归神经网络（SBRNN），在此类信道中的性能显著优于阈值检测。这为MC信道编码提出了一个核心问题：当编码传输与未编码传输均采用神经检测进行评估时，那些其优越性最初是在阈值检测下建立的码是否仍能保持优势？本短文针对游程受限ISI缓解（RLIM）码回答了这一问题，提出了一种解码器感知的训练掩码，该掩码移除了RLIM解码器极大概率会确定性覆盖的位置，从而将紧凑型SBRNN的容量引导至承载信息的位置。掩码RLIM₂-SBRNN在57个工作点中的40个点优于最佳未编码接收机（阈值或SBRNN），并带来了增益。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种解码器感知的训练掩码方法，通过在训练SBRNN神经检测器时屏蔽RLIM解码器大概率会确定性覆盖的位置，将网络容量集中于承载信息的位置，使掩码RLIM₂-SBRNN在57个工作点中的40个点优于最佳未编码接收机。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a decoder-aware training mask that removes positions likely to be deterministically overwritten by the RLIM decoder, steering compact-SBRNN capacity toward information-bearing positions, so that the masked RLIM₂-SBRNN outperforms the best uncoded receiver at 40 of 57 operating points.
